tbesh_html:
1) convex surface, back
1a) back (of man)
1b) mound (for illicit worship)
1c) boss (convex projection of shield)
1d) bulwarks, breastworks (of arguments-fig.)
1e) brow, eyebrow
1f) rim (of wheel)
Aramaic equivalent: gav (גַּב "back" H1355)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: the back (as rounded); by analogy, the top or rim, a boss, a vault, arch of eye, bulwarks, etc.
strongs_1890.derivation: from an unused root meaning to hollow or curve; (compare H1460 (גֵּו) and H1479 (גּוּף))
strongs_1890.kjv_def: back, body, boss, eminent (higher) place, (eye) brows, nave, ring.
